name: Joseph Wakefield
role: Early elder who later turned against the Church
dateNote: He was named in revelations of May and June 1831 and was excommunicated by January 1834.
importance: Section 50 sends him with Parley P. Pratt and John Corrill to strengthen the churches in May 1831. Section 52 sends him to the eastern lands with Solomon Humphrey. On a later mission in New York he baptized George A. Smith. He was excommunicated by 1834 and joined actions against the Saints in Kirtland.
connections: His companions in these sections were Parley P. Pratt and Solomon Humphrey.

sources.title: Joseph H. Wakefield, Joseph Smith Papers biography
Joseph H. Wakefield, Doctrine and Covenants Central

reviewNote: JSP: born 7 July 1792, Dublin, New Hampshire; baptized and an elder by 9 May 1831; high priest 4 June 1831; excommunicated by Jan. 1834; opposed the Saints in 1834; died in Willoughby, Ohio (date only a fragment, 18 Jan. 1835). D&C Central gives 1792–1835 and the George A. Smith baptism (Sept. 1832). JSP calls him Joseph H. Wakefield.
